description: Use this when a signed-in operator asks which domains their DNS Doctor account monitors, or what to do next on them. Lists every domain on the caller's account with its state — verified, pending (added, ownership not proven yet) or verification_lapsed (the ownership record was removed, so monitoring is paused for it) — and next_step, the one thing to do next for that domain. Requires an API token. Relay next_step as given.
name: list_my_domains
title: List My Domains
